component.name: Epic Games Launcher
component.summary: Download, install, and play games from the Epic Games Store

description.p: The Epic Games Launcher is the gateway to all content on the Epic Games store. Install games from your Epic Games account, browse the store, or manage Unreal Engine installations.

screenshot.caption: The "Library" tab, showing a lot of installed games, along with the social panel on the right
The game details pop-up, visible after clicking a game in the library
The "Store" tab, prominently showing the banner of a recently released game
The "Develop" tab, where Unreal Engine installations and related tools can be installed

description.p: A pending update will now stay visible in the Library while the game or tool is running.
On the Unreal Engine page, the counts in Details will now link to the modules and plugins dialog.
A partner install that was stuck waiting in the Library could not be ended from its title.
An error message sometimes appeared incorrectly when opening Fab.
Flicker appeared in Downloads when you reinstalled something while it was being uninstalled.
Installs on a hard disk drive are now up to three times faster.
Library search will now match the words you type in any order and ignore punctuation.
The Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview is now listed with the Unreal Engine 5 releases.
Windows: Notification toasts used to appear even when Do Not Disturb was turned on.
Repair could not be run on an installation that had not finished.
On macOS, Store checkout popups will now open in launcher windows.
Unreal Engine installs could have displayed the pending update's version rather than the installed build.
The previous account's Fab page was not closed when you changed accounts.
Downloads now pause and wait when the destination drive runs out of space.
The Projects table in Develop now lets you choose which columns to display.
Required launcher updates no longer start during a Store checkout.
The error shown when a required launcher update runs out of disk space can now be dismissed.
Fab now uses the language selected in the launcher.
